question: g3_checkout_request
answer:
Created [src/util/checkoutRequest.mjs](~/code/benchmark/okf-local/main/source/work/g3_checkout_request/source/codex/3/src/util/checkoutRequest.mjs) — it's the only file changed. It exports `buildCheckoutRequest(...)`, an ES module with no imports, returning `{method: "POST", path: "cart/<cartCode>/checkout", body}` with the backend's field names:

- shipping option → `quoteId`
- currency → `currency`
- terms accepted → `termsAccepted`
- order comment → `orderNote`
- payment → `payment: {paymentType: "CREDITCARD", transactionType: "CAPTURE", processor, cardToken, amount}`

I verified it runs in Node and produces the expected payload.

Files used:
- [Checkout.js](~/code/benchmark/okf-local/main/source/work/g3_checkout_request/source/codex/3/src/pages/other/Checkout.js) — how the storefront builds and POSTs the request (`cart/<id>/checkout`)
- [constant.js](~/code/benchmark/okf-local/main/source/work/g3_checkout_request/source/codex/3/src/util/constant.js) and [webService.js](~/code/benchmark/okf-local/main/source/work/g3_checkout_request/source/codex/3/src/util/webService.js) — path pieces and the POST method
- Backend: [OrderApi.java](~/code/benchmark/okf-local/pr2/sm-shop/src/main/java/com/salesmanager/shop/store/api/v1/order/OrderApi.java) (the `POST /cart/{code}/checkout` endpoint), plus the order request classes [PersistableOrder.java](~/code/benchmark/okf-local/pr2/sm-shop-model/src/main/java/com/salesmanager/shop/model/order/v1/PersistableOrder.java), [Order.java](~/code/benchmark/okf-local/pr2/sm-shop-model/src/main/java/com/salesmanager/shop/model/order/v1/Order.java), [PersistablePayment.java](~/code/benchmark/okf-local/pr2/sm-shop-model/src/main/java/com/salesmanager/shop/model/order/transaction/PersistablePayment.java) and [PaymentEntity.java](~/code/benchmark/okf-local/pr2/sm-shop-model/src/main/java/com/salesmanager/shop/model/order/transaction/PaymentEntity.java) for the exact field names.

Note: the backend names differ from what Checkout.js currently sends — `shippingQuote`→`quoteId`, `paymentModule`→`processor`, `paymentToken`→`cardToken` — which is why the new util uses the backend names directly.
